data.content: Human clarified Phase 2 target on 2026-07-01: collapse means v3/@hive-flow/cli becomes the new operative root, promoted to top-level cli in the directory layout, not merely deduplicating code while keeping v3 as the root. Everything Hive Flow-related outside that target root, including code, docs/dox/private operational material, scripts, tests, package/install surfaces, and trash/delete classifications, must be audited and collapsed or explicitly placed in a trash/human-cutover bucket. Some moves cannot happen while the current Codex/Claude/router/MCP session is live; those must be compartmentalized as human-required cutover steps rather than forced mid-session.
